button.label: Share
button.help: Give people their own copy to build on, or invite them to work on this with you.

dialog.title: Share “{name}”
dialog.tabCopyHelp: A link anyone can use to make their own copy.
dialog.tabTogetherHelp: Invite people to work on this one with you.
dialog.loadFailed: Couldn't load the sharing settings. Please try again.
dialog.networkError: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
dialog.asDesign: This app is made from a design, so the design is shared.
dialog.asGame: This app is made from a game, so the game is shared.

copy.intro: Anyone with the link signs in (or signs up) and gets their own copy to change and build on. Their changes never reach yours, and yours never reach theirs.
copy.includeDataHint: Rows from the tables your public pages show. Never sign-ins, passwords, your visitors' own entries, or anything only you can see.
copy.includeDataHelp: Copies get example rows so the app isn't empty. People's private data never goes along.
copy.expiryHelp: After this the link stops working. Copies already made stay with the people who made them.
copy.createHelp: Makes a new link. You can turn it off at any time.
copy.copyLinkHelp: Copies the link so you can send it to people.
copy.copiesMade: {count, plural, =0 {No copies yet} one {# copy made} other {# copies made}}
copy.revokeHelp: Stops this link working. Copies already made stay with the people who made them.
copy.revokeConfirm: Turn off this link? Nobody can make new copies with it. Copies already made stay with the people who made them.
copy.noCopies: Nobody has made a copy yet.

app.flows: Workflows, with your private keys left blank
app.tables: The structure of your data tables
app.data: Sample rows, when you include sample data
app.look: Theme, icon and added features (their private keys left blank)
app.phone: Phone app name, colours and permission wording
app.media: The pictures and files the pages use

design.files: Every page and file of the design
design.app: It gets its own app the first time they build it

game.files: The game's files as they are now
game.plan: Its plan: brief, art direction, assets, branding and the feature list
game.version: One starting version with its newest screenshot

never.payment: Payment keys and other private keys
never.signing: Android signing keys and app store accounts
never.domains: Custom domains and the app's own web address
never.push: Push notification subscribers and their credentials
never.published: Published versions: the copy starts unpublished
never.people: Your visitors' accounts, sign-ins, passwords and their own entries
never.owner: Analytics, logs and owner-only settings such as alerts
never.gameApp: The published game and its address

together.intro: Invite people by email to work on this with you. It stays yours, and you can remove them at any time.
together.emailHelp: They accept the invitation while signed in with this address.
together.roleHelp: Editors change it and build with AI; viewers can only look.
together.editorHint: Editors change it and build with AI, using their own AI allowance. They can't delete, publish or transfer it, invite others, or see its keys, domains and billing.
together.viewerHint: Viewers can look at everything in the studio but can't change anything.
together.notSent: Email isn't set up on this server, so no email went out. Send {email} this link:
together.updated: {email} is now {role, select, viewer {a viewer} other {an editor}}.
together.noPeople: Nobody else works on this yet.
together.resendHelp: Sends a new invitation; the old link stops working.
together.removeHelp: Takes their access away right away.
together.removeConfirm: Remove {email}? They lose access right away.
together.activityHelp: Who changed what since this was shared.

banner.editor: You're working on {owner}'s {kind, select, app {app} design {design} game {game} other {project}} as an editor. Publishing, keys and domains stay with them.
banner.viewer: You're looking at {owner}'s {kind, select, app {app} design {design} game {game} other {project}} as a viewer. You can't change it.
banner.leaveHelp: Stop working on this. Its owner can invite you again.
banner.leaveConfirm: Leave “{name}”? You won't be able to open it any more unless they invite you again.

credit.hideHelp: Removes this note from your copy.

page.title: {from} shared {kind, select, app {an app} design {a design} game {a game} other {something}} with you
page.intro: Make your own copy to change and build on. It's yours: what you change never reaches {from}, and what they change never reaches you.
page.nameHelp: You can rename it later too.
page.makeHelp: Creates your own copy in your account and opens it.
page.tables: {count, plural, one {# data table} other {# data tables}}
page.languages: {count, plural, one {# extra language} other {# extra languages}}
page.own: This is yours. Making a copy works like duplicating it.
page.gone: It may have been turned off, or what it shared was deleted. Ask the person who shared it for a new link.
page.expired: Ask the person who shared it for a new link.
page.revoked: Ask the person who shared it for a new link.
page.workspaceTitle: This link is for another workspace
page.workspace: It can't be used with this account. Sign in with an account of the same workspace, or ask for another way to share it.
page.done: Your copy is ready. Opening it…
page.aiNotice: If this app uses AI, add your own AI key to it before you publish: copies never get the original's keys.

shared.title: Shared with me
shared.help: Apps, designs and games other people invited you to work on.
shared.leaveHelp: Stop working on this. Its owner can invite you again.
shared.leaveConfirm: Leave “{name}”? You won't be able to open it any more unless they invite you again.
shared.invite: {from} invited you to work on “{title}” as {role, select, viewer {a viewer} other {an editor}}.
shared.acceptHelp: Adds it to Shared with me.
shared.needsLink: To accept, open the link in the invitation email.

invite.title: Work on “{title}” together
invite.body: {from} invited you to work on the {kind, select, app {app} design {design} game {game} other {project}} “{title}” as {role, select, viewer {a viewer} other {an editor}}.
invite.editor: As an editor you can change it and build with AI (from your own AI allowance). It stays theirs.
invite.viewer: As a viewer you can look at everything in it, but not change it.
invite.acceptHelp: Adds it to Shared with me and opens it.
invite.wrongAccount: This invitation was sent to {email}, but you're signed in as {me}. Sign out and sign in with {email} to accept it.
invite.goneTitle: This invitation isn't there any more
invite.gone: It may have been accepted already, or the owner removed it.

editor.otherSave: {name} also saved this page after you opened it ({time}). The newest save is kept. Reload to see their changes before you go on.
editor.otherSaveSomeone: Someone else also saved this page after you opened it ({time}). The newest save is kept. Reload to see their changes before you go on.
